# Fraud Detection

Sequence rules use cookies to track the order and timing of requests

## Fraud Detection documentation pages

- [Sequence rules](https://developers.cloudflare.com/bots/additional-configurations/sequence-rules/index.md): Detect and mitigate bot traffic based on cookie-based request sequences.
